searchText: b"h — safeguards/ server safeguards program (user order 2026 10 20: "do it all"). born from the 2026 10 20 flap: one directory sitting where a file was expected threw eisdir, busted the grouped cache, forced a 197 mb rescan, and flapped the whole site every 2 minutes. prime directive for everything in this directory: one bad record degrades one read. it never throws, never rescans, never takes the site with it. modules file role safeguardstate.js state dir + append only line log primitives. no json state files (user law); writes never throw. poisonquarantine.js per path error counts; a path with 2+ errors is quarantined and skipped without being read. persists as line logs in the state dir. saferecordread.js the poison proof read helper. wrap any stored record read: fallback on error, shape validation, quarantine aware. fullscanwatch.js full scan incident counter. every whole shard scan logs [fullscan incident] + one line in state/fullscan incidents.log; serves fullscanslasthour() to the pulse endpoint. shapeaudit.js standalone audit (nice n 19 node shapeaudit.js): finds entries whose file vs dir shape mismatches reader expectations before a reader trips on them. report in state/shape audit.log. yieldevery.js cooperative time budget yield helper for long loops (phase 3). first applied site: the backlink grouping pass. readshed.js read side shed verdict (phase 3): circuit/heap/os ram sensors only — never the import busy check. heavy reads fail fast with 503 before heavy work; see routes/packed/readme safeguards.md. pulseroute.js payload for get /api/social/health/pulse (phase 4, mounted by awtsmoos.health.js): loop lag p95, heap mb, os free mb, disk free gb, scans/hour, uptime. resourcealarm.js 5 minute disk/ram tripwire (phase 4): disk \t \t \t poison quarantine.log — \t fullscan incidents.log — \t \t shape audit.log — audit report sections alarms.log — (phase 4) disk/ram alarm lines ai safeguard rules for this directory 1. nothing here may throw into a request path. catch, log, degrade. 2. no synchronous i/o in request path modules (scripts excepted). 3. no json state files, ever. append only text lines only. 4. every module stays ≤120 lines with the 3 line b"h header, tab indentation, and jsdoc — the tunnel guard enforces it on write. 5. a full scan of any shard is an incident by definition. if you add one, wire fullscanwatch.notefullscan() at its entry.
